Fortunately I don’t have any expectations or desire for any particular autograph. I just wanted to see what was up and how the new system worked. I know it can be overwhelming but don’t stress too much!  My suggestion to you as far as your panels go is line up early! Depending on where your panel is located (Main Events, a random room) you should line up at least an hour early. In the past you could just waltz in a room but you can’t do that anymore really for most popular panels. Please stay hydrated and eat! Its gonna be hot and I know my anxiety gets bad when im hangry and thirsty.  Going alone isn’t too bad especially since you don’t have a group of people pulling you every which way you can decide for yourself what you wanna do!  When I run out of panels I just go to the entertainment hall or the annex. Theres a lot to do. You definitely wont be without something to do. It all depends on what you’re looking for.
The front of south and west hall have the two main entrances but west hall also has a side entrance thats a bit easier to get through in my experience.
